svg.title: Basic Mode: The Courier's Strongbox setup and an example score
svg.desc: Show the Appendix B setup constraints (zones, Monster Entry band, terrain types) and one source-supported carrying and scoring example.

g.text: Schematic. Grey dashed = position not fixed.
Group and Satchel are drawn beside each Entry
marker; groups are assigned at random.

svg.text: Placement rules and an example score

text.tspan: a road across the centre; 2 ruins, carts or low walls within 4" of the

svg.text: centre; 4 more 3"×3" pieces, one in each quarter. Ruins are Blocking, carts
and low walls Impassable, other pieces Cover.

text.tspan: each side deploys within 4" of opposite battlefield edges.
3 markers around the centre, each 5–7" from it, at

svg.text: least 4" from each other and outside both deployment zones. The 3 groups
(4 Goblins, 4 Skeleton Warriors, 4 Bandits) are assigned to the markers at
random, one complete group per marker, with 1 Satchel on each marker.

text.tspan: the Strongbox (12c) at the centre; 3 Satchels (4c each). A carrier of

svg.text: the Strongbox has -2" Speed, to a minimum of 1".

text.tspan: leave the battlefield through your own deployment edge;

svg.text: remove the carrier from play and add the carried treasure's Coin Value to

text.tspan: Example (assumed): Ironscar, SPD 4", carries the Strongbox from the

svg.text: Centre to an edge, open ground
An adjacent, unengaged combatant picks up the Strongbox or a Satchel
with Interact [1 AP]. Coin Values: Goblin 1c, Skeleton Warrior 1c, Bandit 3c
(B.5). The game ends after Round 6; the higher score wins. Ties: the
